mcp_tools.name: tested_authorization_policy_pack
mcp_tools.title: Tested authorization policy pack
mcp_tools.description: Submit a declared authorization policy pack manifest (decision model, policy code, declared policies and their tests, rollout, decision logs, governance and enforcement); get a deterministic READY / NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed default-deny and per-policy test-coverage checks that name untested policies, with per-check evidence. Declared evidence only; no policy is executed.

inputSchema.description: The policy-pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and the policies[]/tests[] schemas).

decision_model.description: Decision-model evidence (enumerated decisions, input schema, default deny).

policies.description: Declared policies: ids, effect, and the tests that cover them.

policy_code.description: Policy-code evidence (composability, data/logic separation, versioning, explanations).

tests.description: Declared policy tests: policy id, kind (positive/negative/edge), and outcome.

testing.description: Testing-posture evidence (tests green, lint/format, role coverage declared).

rollout.description: Rollout evidence (shadow mode, staged enforcement, rollback).

enforcement.description: Enforcement evidence (bypass paths, silent-edit prohibition, fail-closed behaviour).
